global_gates.description: A reviewed validator commit adds the exact theorem names to ACTIVATED_RESEARCH_TARGETS after every other gate is closed. Schema version 1 of this matrix cannot express activation.
The regenerated catalog from the validated derived source commit contains all 30 theorems as DIRECT_PROP, research open, depends_on_sorry true, with canonical type hashes recorded in this matrix.

All 60 staged frozen proof/refutation payload inspectors and checker controls rerun on the candidate toolchain; every frozen rejected payload is actually rejected and no passing log is reused from another toolchain.

The candidate verifier image passes the worker's production doctor argv as UID 10001 with the noexec work tmpfs, and the negative controls (executable work mount, root user) report the sandbox unready.
A dated release-time status and literature screen for each target, recorded like the existing pool selection audits. Source-review acceptance is not a novelty certificate.
Owner approval of the reward policy and amounts for package-authored targets, including the correlated Frankl group and the target 12 exclusion.
Maintainer review of the research-targets source family: status source, selection-audit evidence format, and package-authored attribution.
Candidate Lean 4.35.0-rc2 / Mathlib 065356127b1d source with the Math15 and Math30 libraries builds with zero errors, and the support libraries pass the sorry and axiom audit.

reward_groups.rationale: Targets 7-9 share a hypothetical minimal-counterexample antecedent; the proper-cover and full-cover branches need not be disjoint, so one sufficiently strong theorem could discharge several targets. This does not show the three statements are equivalent. Hold all three until an explicit correlated-payout decision is recorded.

target_gates.description: A compliant certificate or proof route is demonstrated at full size and its verifier time and memory are measured within the published task limits. An impractical certificate format or an unmeasured computed certificate does not satisfy this.
Cite the published justification for the extra hypothesis in the statement (the known four-speed 1/5 lower bound) in the source docstring.
An explicit decision on correlated rewards for the shared-antecedent group.
Document in the source that primitivity repairs a scaling problem in the literal source question.
Review of the public conditional cycle-exclusion claim and its hypotheses against the exact target.
Resource and proof-route benchmark showing a compliant proof is feasible within verifier limits; large known certificate routes justify benchmarks, not impossibility claims.
Correct the catalog literature baseline (the unconditional m <= 3e result) and recheck the target.
Release-time refresh of rapidly changing lower-bound literature.
Independent source novelty check for the exact statement.
Label the statement as a package-authored proposed answer for a narrower regime, not the source's verbatim conjecture.
Visually verify the exact survey cell (DS1.18 Table IXa, printed page 36) that the statement relies on.
Representative witness tests under the pinned static policy and verifier limits; submissions cannot raise options.

Claims that the target is unprovable or already solved are not established.
